title: How to Design a Hellion and More!

entities.name: Doug Beyer
entities.description: Host of the framing 'Flavorful Design' transcript, who explains how to design Magic's signature creatures.

entities.name: Hellion
entities.description: A huge scaly, snakelike creature with a toothy round mouth ringed by tentacles, a manifestation of nature's blind rage.

entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: A character whose warning to run is referenced in the discussion of Lhurgoyfs.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: A voracious creature that gains power and toughness by devouring other creatures.

entities.name: Thelon of Havenwood
entities.description: An Elf who long ago bred and nurtured Thallids as a food source.

entities.name: Thallid
entities.description: A fungal race bred by Thelon of Havenwood that buds off Saprolings almost constantly.

entities.name: Saproling
entities.description: A sporelike organism budded off by Thallids.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: A place where Saprolings budded off of Thallids all the time.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where Saprolings occur although Thallids do not exist there.

entities.name: Thrull
entities.description: A servant race bred as sacrifices, often more useful dead than alive.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The order that bred Thrulls as sacrifices.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: A master breeder whose experimentation made increasingly versatile and powerful Thrulls.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: An ill-fated breeding project mourned with a moment of silence.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Artifact creatures native to Mirrodin, mostly tiny errand-runners.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The world native to the Myr.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The planar regent of Mirrodin, whose eyes and ears are the Myr.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Savage-minded reptilian humanoids descended from Dragons.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which a creature born of Rath reasserted itself.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane that gave rise to the Lhurgoyf.

events.summary: The Order of the Ebon Hand breeds Thrulls as sacrifices.

events.summary: Endrek Sahr's experiments yield ever more versatile and powerful Thrulls.
events.quote: resulted in generation after generation of increasingly versatile

events.summary: Thrull subspecies bred for intelligence and combat overwhelm their masters.
